_notes.leagueSlug: Find your league slug by calling GET https://api.opticodds.com/api/v3/leagues?sport=soccer with your API key. Use the 'id' or 'slug' field from the response.
_notes.teamIds: OpticOdds team IDs come from the fixtures/results response (home_team_id / away_team_id). Run the workflow once, inspect Extract Teams output to get the exact IDs and names, then populate this map.
_notes.teamNames: Names must match home_team_display / away_team_display exactly as returned by OpticOdds.
